'END U.S. WARS OF AGGRESSION'

Labor group Kilusang Mayo Uno stages protest at the US Embassy in Manila today, March 23, 2026, in continued calls to end US-led wars of aggression in West Asia, particularly in Palestine and Iran.

They also echo calls to abolish Visiting Forces Agreement (VFA) and Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement (EDCA) between the US and the Philippines. The labor group stresses that such deals with the United States poses dangers of Filipinos being dragged into senseless, imperialist war. 

Photos courtesy of Kilusang Mayo Uno
